metadata.name: IsaacFPS
metadata.description:
IsaacFPS - FPS booster and performance toolkit for big mod collections.
Reduces stutter and wasted work when many mods are loaded: - GC tuning (fewer garbage-collection hitches from heavy Lua mods) - Sound spam dedupe (native REPENTOGON MC_PRE_SFX_PLAY hook when available, SFXManager wrapper otherwise) - Debug log spam filter (Isaac.DebugString rate limiting) - Overlay freezing while paused - Throttled render/update callback library with automatic detail scaling - Shared Font cache and per-frame memoization cache - Built-in diagnostics: FPS overlay, fpsbench() benchmark, frame spike report
Optional REPENTOGON integration (repentogon.com): ImGui performance dashboard with frame time and memory graphs, registered console commands with tab completion and macros, nanosecond frame timing, and GC-awareness. Everything works without REPENTOGON too.
Type fpshelp() in the debug console for all commands.
